title: Oompa Loompa's Vanilla+ Experience
description: A modpack that enhances the Vanilla experience as much as possible, without changing the functionality or gameplay.
body:
IT'S TIME FOR THE 2 WEEK PHASE OF MINECRAFT AGAIN!!!

This modpack intends on keeping the Vanilla experience as Vanilla as possible, to make it friendly to new Minecraft players, while also bringing some refreshing aesthetic and QOL changes to increase immersion for seasoned players. To help with those who have lower end computers, a bunch of optimisation mods are also included.

Aesthetic changes include improved visuals that update animations, and textures, as well as changes to sounds and sound physics.

**IMPORTANT NOTE FOR APPLE SILICON USERS**\
If the game gets stuck on the Mojang splash screen, disable/delete Distant Horizons. I'm unsure as to why it doesn't work currently.
